Together they cover all four sub-items: trust boundaries named (security-spec.md B1-B4, :5-33); authorization/access mechanism at each boundary (security-spec.md:59-67, guard-enforced PROTECTED_GATE_SUFFIXES for the one write-relevant boundary; no user-facing auth boundary exists since MCP runs as a local stdio child process); data classification (security-spec.md:48-57, 'No secrets are read, written, or transported by this feature'); and threat-model coverage via STRIDE (security-spec.md:35-46) covering the OWASP-equivalent concerns relevant to this feature's actual surface (no injection or broken-auth surface exists, since there is no user input reaching an interpreter and no new auth boundary).
